To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the unsteady wake of airfoil is influenced by the mean angle of attack and the amplitude of oscillation.
the wake of an oscillating airfoil at a high reduced frequency of 0.18 is strongly affected by the amplitude and the mean angle of attack.
the unsteady wake of a pitching airfoil is affected by the amplitude of oscillation and the mean angle of attack.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the unsteady wake of a pitching airfoil in a subsonics flow and the results are presented for a wide range of mean and maximum angles of attack.
the effect of oscillation amplitude, mean angle of attack and their combinations on wake profiles.
unsteady wake behind an airfoil in pitching oscillation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the unsteady wake behind an oscillating airfoil depends on the amplitude and the mean angle of attack of the oscillating airfoil.
the effects of oscillation amplitude and the mean angle of attack on the wake profiles are strongly dependent on the dynamic angle of attack.
, for the present study, the wake profiles are affected by the amplitude and mean angle-of-attack of the oscillating airfoil.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the unsteady effects on wake profiles are strongly related to the dynamic stall phenomena.

the wake of an oscillating airfoil is strongly dependent on the mean angle of attack and amplitude of oscillation, especially when the maximum dynamic angle is greater than static stall angle of airfoil.
the mean angle of attack has a strong effect on the wake profile and the oscillation amplitude has a weak effect on wake profile.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the wake profiles are strongly affected by the mean angle of attack, but weakly affected by the amplitude of the oscillation.
the mean velocity profiles are affected by both amplitude and mean angle, and the effect of mean angle is more pronounced.
the wake profiles can be used to determine the unsteady effects on the wake and the wake can be used to predict the aerodynamic performance of the airfoil.
